messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Top‑ranked tennis players (as of the most recent weekly rankings)**  

| Category | Rank | Player | Nationality | Notes |
|----------|------|--------|-------------|-------|
| **ATP (Men’s)** | 1 | **Novak Djokovic** | Serbia | Djokovic has reclaimed the No. 1 spot after a strong finish to the 2026 season, including a deep run at the US Open and a solid performance on clay. |
| **WTA (Women’s)** | 1 | **Iga Świątek** | Poland | Świątek remains at the top of the rankings thanks to her consistent results on hard courts and her victory at the 2026 French Open. |

> **Why the rankings matter**  
> The ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday based on a player’s performance over the previous 52 weeks. They determine seedings in tournaments, entry into events, and are a key indicator of a player’s form and consistency.

> **How to verify or stay updated**  
> * ATP Rankings: <https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles>  
> * WTA Rankings: <https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/singles>  

> **Keep in mind**  
> Rankings can shift quickly—especially after major tournaments—so the “current” top player may change within days. If you’re following a specific event or need the latest snapshot, check the official ATP/WTA sites or reputable sports news outlets.
